assertion: Text inherits paint-order. Painting the centered stroke before the opaque fill preserves the interiors of CJK and Latin glyphs without changing line layout.

browser.reason: All three browsers preserve opaque CJK and Latin interiors with stroke before fill. Chrome, Firefox and Valle agree on the baselines (66/136); WebKit differs by 0.092px. Reviewed Chrome differences are 12902 glyph-edge pixels (max 235), plus 13 adjacent pixels outside the contour mask (max 87). Flat regions remain checked. Reverting to normal order fails both budgets; missing or displaced text must also fail.
